description: Defines data structures and function prototypes for managing RBUS subscriptions, including creation, destruction, addition, retrieval, removal, and cache resubscription of subscription objects.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_create
methods.description: Creates a new subscriptions registry for an rbus handle.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription with a unique key [listener, eventName, filter].

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves an existing subscription by its unique key.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_onTableRowAdded
methods.description: Called right after a new row is added to a table.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_onTableRowRemoved
methods.description: Called right before an existing row is deleted from a table.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_resubscribeElementCache
methods.description: Resubscribes listeners when registering an event data element from cache.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_resubscribeRowElementCache
methods.description: Resubscribes listeners when registering a row of a table from cache.

methods.name: rbusSubscriptions_handleClientDisconnect
methods.description: Unsubscribes clients when they disconnect, handling cases like crashes.
